issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the abstract feeding method: the problem statement text instructs students to implement and call a method named getFeedingSound(), whereas the UML and the provided solution use an abstract method named messageOnFeed() on class Animal. Specifically, the problem statement (instructions for Part 2 and Part 3) refers to getFeedingSound(), but the solution defines public abstract String messageOnFeed() in Animal and the solution Farm implementation calls animal.messageOnFeed(). This mismatch will confuse students about which method to implement and which method feedAllAnimals() / singFarmSongVerse should call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the feeding method name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred minimal change: update the problem statement and any template comments to refer to messageOnFeed() (matching the UML and solution). Also update template Farm.java to call animal.messageOnFeed() where appropriate (feedAllAnimals and singFarmSongVerse). Alternatively, if the course prefers the name getFeedingSound(), rename the abstract method in Animal and all solution usages to getFeedingSound() and update the UML and problem text accordingly. Ensure examples and instructions consistently use the same identifier.

issues.description: Concept: the animal feeding-sound method used to obtain the sound an animal makes when fed. Problem statement: the UML and the solution use the identifier messageOnFeed(). Problem statement (parts of the narrative and verse template) also use getFeedingSound() and the textual tasks for Seal/Pig/Goat instruct students to implement getFeedingSound(). Template: Farm.java has placeholders and TODOs that imply calling an animal feeding method when building the song. Solution: Animal.java and Farm.java implement and call messageOnFeed(). Confusion: students may implement getFeedingSound() (as the prose and verse placeholders ask) while the provided solution/tests and UML expect messageOnFeed(), or vice versa, causing a mismatch between the implemented method name and the required tests or the provided template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the feeding-sound method name across all artifacts. Preferred resolution: change all occurrences of getFeedingSound() in problem_statement.md (task descriptions and song template placeholders) to messageOnFeed(), and update any template comments to reference messageOnFeed(). Alternatively, explicitly document that getFeedingSound() in the narrative is equivalent to messageOnFeed() and update the template to provide a delegating alias (e.g., add getFeedingSound() that calls messageOnFeed()) so students can use either name without being blocked. Ensure tests and solution code use the same identifier (messageOnFeed()).
